sentences.text: On 1.27, `matchLabelKeys` is described only for topology spread constraints and not for pod affinity rules.

citations.quote: matchLabelKeys is a list of pod label keys to select the pods over which spreading will be calculated

sentences.text: On 1.31, an optional `matchLabelKeys` field is available for Pod affinity or anti‑affinity rules.

citations.quote: Kubernetes includes an optional `matchLabelKeys` field for Pod affinity or anti‑affinity
